title: Constructible cohomology after tensoring with one finite constant module
statement: Let $X$ be a Noetherian scheme [def-pc-scheme], $A$ a commutative Noetherian ring [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring] in the independent coefficient universe, and $K$ an object of the actual constant-$A$ pro-etale derived category [lem-sfb-adic-finite-reduction-data]. Assume $K$ is bounded with affine-locally constructible cohomology [sk-def-sfb-bounded-constructible]. Let $M$ be a finitely generated $A$-module [def-weil-finitely-generated-module]. Realize $M$ by the exact constant module functor [def-sfb-site-derived-constant-module-functor] in degree zero, and use the existing K-flat tensor [lem-weil-pbc-kflat-fixed-tensor-triangulated] to form $K\otimes_A^{\mathbf L}\underline M[0]$. For every integer $q$, its $q$-th cohomology is affine-locally constructible over $A$ [def-sfb-affine-locally-constructible-proetale-modules]. No flatness or projective-dimension assumption on $M$ is made, and no lower cohomology bound is concluded.

source.place: Tag 09BQ, lemma-tensor-c, common-stratification proof, with sites-cohomology.tex Tag 094H, lemma-locally-constant-tensor-product.

proof.text: For each degree in the finite cohomology interval use the Noetherian affine-local/global constructibility equivalence. Induct over that finite set, intersecting scheme stratifications with Stratification.inter. Pull the finite local models along the actual fibre-product projections using coefficientProEtale_finite_comp. The empty family uses Stratification.trivial.

The cohomological bound shows that every nonzero input degree belongs to the finite interval, so the common stratification trivializes all nonzero cohomology. Apply the local constant tensor calculation to each stratum immersion; only the upper bound of K and finiteness of M enter this local calculation.

Convert finite local values to finitely presented values over the Noetherian coefficient ring. The same common stratification witnesses global constructibility of each output cohomology sheaf, hence the Noetherian global/affine-local equivalence gives the claimed affine-local constructibility.

proof_origin.note: A5: Lean proves the finite common-stratification argument by fibre-product induction and the final constructibility assembly. The independent local tensor calculation is isolated in lem-sfb-coefficient-constant-tensor-local-models; this is a decomposition, not a claim of an axiom-free proof.
